size.evidence: network_game_add_machine and network_game_update_machine copy exactly 0x44 bytes; network_game_server_invalidate_network_machine clears 0x44 bytes

stride.evidence: network_game_add_machine and network_game_update_machine index four records with i*0x44

fields.name: name
fields.evidence: network_game_server timeout handling converts game+0x11c+machine_index*0x44 to ASCII as a wide-character machine name; the 0x44-byte record has 0x40 bytes before its index byte

fields.name: machine_index
fields.evidence: network_machine_is_valid range-checks signed byte +0x40; network_game_add_machine uses it to select a game slot and network_game_server_get_client_machine writes it as the copied slot index

notes: The two machine-index offsets are distinct fields in distinct record contexts: +0x0c belongs to the live server machine object, while +0x40 is the copied network-game machine record field used by network_game_manager.
All other bytes are bulk-copied or cleared but have no field-level evidence in the consulted functions; they remain implicit gaps in this partial layout.
